entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your good luck shines on your people, even in the most trying times.

Prerequisite(s): Hold the Ruler leadership role for a kingdom.

Benefit(s): During a kingdom’s Event phase, once an event’s type and danger level has been determined, you may choose to roll twice on the applicable kingdom or settlement table and choose either result. You must declare you are using this feat before the results of the initial roll are revealed.
